event: He stays on the threshold-stone and welds the Warden's chain to the maul's butt with his own heat.

changes.note: The weld-heat is drawn from his own ember, the core being low

changes.from: A twin-headed maul of ember-bound iron, a living core clad in its head.
changes.to: A twin-headed maul of ember-bound iron, a living core clad in its head, a chain at the free end.
changes.note: The Warden's chain is welded to the maul's butt

event: Weight rocked back behind the line, he swings the chained maul and hurls it into the gold.
It sails through feast and host alike, finding nothing: the host is a painting in the air.
After many casts it bites something real, and he drags out a tangle of old human bone.

changes.note: Cast after cast of the chained maul

event: Snagged among the ribs comes a snapped length of cold iron, a dead man's broken blade.

make.title: Snapped cold-iron blade
make.description: A snapped length of cold iron, pitted, sheared off at a third of its length.

changes.note: Dragged out of the haven's bones on the chained maul

event: The welcome warms and re-gilds where he tears the truth out, pulling harder to bring him in.
